dedupe_keys.name: dublin building energy profiles and building and neighbourhood data ber with prime2 context

description: These two related Mendeley Data datasets by Nasim Eslamirad and colleagues at University College Dublin describe buildings in Dublin, Ireland for building energy analysis. Both start from the national Building Energy Rating data sourced from GeoDirectory, with building-scale fields such as area, height, number of floors, roof type, construction age, energy rating, radon emission, HVAC details, water and space heating source and estimated bedroom and bathroom counts. They add neighbourhood attributes derived from the Tailte Éireann PRIME2 digital landscape model: nearest neighbouring buildings, built environment density, green to non-green area ratio, soil, water bodies, roads and other land uses. The Building Energy Profiles dataset has four versions (latest June 2024); the Building and Neighborhood Data dataset, including a statistically processed version, has four versions (latest September 2024). Coverage: buildings in Dublin, Ireland. Access: CSV files on Mendeley Data. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. The work was funded by Science Foundation Ireland under the NexSys programme. Caveats: latitude, longitude and addresses were removed for data protection, so records cannot be mapped to individual buildings. Simulation uses are statistical and machine-learning models linking building form and neighbourhood context to energy rating, and archetype building for urban energy models. Related records: the Dublin building database (DUBLD) record.
name: Dublin building energy profiles and building and neighbourhood data (BER with PRIME2 context)
notes: One record for both Mendeley datasets: they share authors, source data and description and differ only in processing.
